claims.text: Reviewers widely report the tint works well and delivers natural-looking, fuller brows, especially for people with sparse or light eyebrows.
Many users say the product is easy to use and mixes/applies simply, though some note the capsule is hard to open and the dye stains skin without care.
Several reviewers mention leaving the dye on longer (e.g., 3–10 minutes) to achieve a darker, longer-lasting result.
Users report the tint lasts well, though some say it fades with washing and lasts about a week rather than weeks.
One reviewer strongly warns against using the product on eyebrows.

qa.q: Is it worth the price for spot coloring?
qa.answer: Reviews suggest good value: one kit can last a long time since there's more powder per capsule than needed [1], and half a capsule can suffice for more uses [6]. It also lasts longer than alternatives, needing use only twice a month versus twice a week [2].
